title: dryopteris deltoidea
intro: Dryopteris deltoidea, commonly known as Delta-fern or Delta-wood fern, is a species of fern native to tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris deltoidea include reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
